lessonRecords.target: Students will understand how to convert proper fractions to decimals using long division.
lessonRecords.activities:
1. Warm-up fractions drill
2. Teacher demonstration of numerator divided by denominator
3. Paired whiteboard calculations
4. Exit slip evaluation

clipboardItems.label: Monday — 6A Target
clipboardItems.plainText: Students will understand how to convert proper fractions to decimals using long division.

clipboardItems.label: Monday — 6A Activities
clipboardItems.plainText:
1. Warm-up fractions drill
2. Teacher demonstration of numerator divided by denominator
3. Paired whiteboard calculations
4. Exit slip evaluation

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 1 — Objective
clipboardItems.plainText: Master dividing numerator by denominator with no remainder.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 1 — Teacher Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Direct instruction showing 3/4 = 0.75 and 1/2 = 0.5 on interactive board.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 1 — Student Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Write decimal equivalents on individual mini-whiteboards with partner confirmation.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 1 — Resources / Materials
clipboardItems.plainText: Math Notebooks, dry-erase whiteboards, grid paper.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 1 — Assessment / Check for Understanding
clipboardItems.plainText: Exit ticket #1: Convert 5/8 to a decimal.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 2 — Objective
clipboardItems.plainText: Recognize terminating versus repeating decimals.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 2 — Teacher Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Introduce repeating notation (bar notation) with 1/3 and 2/3 examples.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 2 — Student Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Categorize 6 decimal fractions as terminating or repeating.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 2 — Resources / Materials
clipboardItems.plainText: Classification T-Chart handout.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 2 — Assessment / Check for Understanding
clipboardItems.plainText: Thumbs up/down check for understanding.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 3 — Objective
clipboardItems.plainText: Apply fraction-to-decimal conversion in real-world recipe problems.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 3 — Teacher Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Guide recipe scaling scenario requiring 3/4 cup converted to decimal measurement.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 3 — Student Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Calculate ingredient measurements in teams.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 3 — Resources / Materials
clipboardItems.plainText: Recipe Task Cards.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6A • Block 3 — Assessment / Check for Understanding
clipboardItems.plainText: Turn in group task card solution.

clipboardItems.label: Monday — 6B Target
clipboardItems.plainText: Students will convert fractions to decimals and compare decimal magnitudes on a number line.

clipboardItems.label: Monday — 6B Activities
clipboardItems.plainText: Group line-up activity with decimal cards, workbook exercises 4A through 4D.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 1 — Objective
clipboardItems.plainText: Plot 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 accurately on an open number line.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 1 — Teacher Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Demonstrate benchmark fractions on floor number line.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 1 — Student Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Place student index cards in correct sequential positions.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 1 — Resources / Materials
clipboardItems.plainText: Number Line tape, student index cards.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 1 — Assessment / Check for Understanding
clipboardItems.plainText: Observation checklist during placement.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 2 — Objective
clipboardItems.plainText: Compare decimals using greater than, less than, and equal signs.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 2 — Teacher Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Review place-value comparison method (tenths vs hundredths).

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 2 — Student Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Complete paired inequality worksheet p. 34.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 2 — Resources / Materials
clipboardItems.plainText: Workbook Chapter 4.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 2 — Assessment / Check for Understanding
clipboardItems.plainText: Score 4-question warm down.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 3 — Objective
clipboardItems.plainText: Independent practice converting mixed numbers to decimals.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 3 — Teacher Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Circulate to provide Tier 2 scaffolding.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 3 — Student Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Work through problem set 10 to 18 independently.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 3 — Resources / Materials
clipboardItems.plainText: Math practice booklet.

clipboardItems.label: Monday 6B • Block 3 — Assessment / Check for Understanding
clipboardItems.plainText: Teacher stamp on notebook check.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday — 6A Target
clipboardItems.plainText: Students will add and subtract decimals with unequal decimal places.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday — 6A Activities
clipboardItems.plainText: Place-value grid alignment exercise, grocery receipt budgeting simulation.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 1 — Objective
clipboardItems.plainText: Line up decimal points vertically before adding or subtracting.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 1 — Teacher Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Emphasize place value zero placeholders for trailing digits.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 1 — Student Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Rewrite 5 horizontal addition problems into vertical grid format.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 1 — Resources / Materials
clipboardItems.plainText: Grid paper sheets.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 1 — Assessment / Check for Understanding
clipboardItems.plainText: Visual check of student notebooks.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 2 — Objective
clipboardItems.plainText: Add multi-digit decimals including regrouping across place values.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 2 — Teacher Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Model regrouping from hundredths to tenths with color-coded markers.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 2 — Student Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Solve 4 guided calculation problems in pairs.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 2 — Resources / Materials
clipboardItems.plainText: Color dry-erase markers.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 2 — Assessment / Check for Understanding
clipboardItems.plainText: Partner check protocol.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 3 — Objective
clipboardItems.plainText: Calculate total cost and change from grocery receipt simulation.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 3 — Teacher Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Provide receipt scenario: $20 budget, 4 items with decimal pricing.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 3 — Student Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Calculate subtotal and change remaining from $20.00.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 3 — Resources / Materials
clipboardItems.plainText: Sample grocery store receipts.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 3 — Assessment / Check for Understanding
clipboardItems.plainText: Accurate change calculation submission.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 4 — Objective
clipboardItems.plainText: Identify and correct common misconceptions in decimal subtraction.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 4 — Teacher Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Present error analysis slide with misaligned decimal point.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 4 — Student Activity
clipboardItems.plainText: Write brief explanation of the error and provide corrected answer.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 4 — Resources / Materials
clipboardItems.plainText: Slide projection.

clipboardItems.label: Tuesday 6A • Block 4 — Assessment / Check for Understanding
clipboardItems.plainText: Exit slip explanation.

clipboardItems.label: Wednesday — 7A Target
clipboardItems.plainText: Students will solve two-step linear equations using inverse operations.

clipboardItems.label: Wednesday — 7A Activities
clipboardItems.plainText: Balance scale visualization, step-by-step inverse operation practice, group relay.
